observations: Independently viewed the shared available-blink-1 anchor and all three canonical images at original detail. Each image contains one MIST face with connected focused C-eye strokes, a small closed mouth, no body or bezel, and no detached facial marks.

Face footprint, eye spacing, mouth location and terminal placement remain visually stable across the triple. Cyan is somewhat brighter than the anchor but stays coherent within the same turquoise-on-dark palette.

The terminal outline and both chevrons persist below and to the right of the face, with ample clearance from eyes and mouth. The cursor is visible in every pose: first row, second row, then the end of the second row.

The cursor progression and restrained finish smile make the three poses meaningful. Pose 2 has no broken eye arc or stray mark; the down-right gaze change is much less legible than the cursor movement.

observations: Independently viewed the shared available-blink-1 anchor and all three canonical images at original detail. Each image retains one MIST face, open C eyes, the same small closed mouth and a stable face footprint.

The lower-right open book stays visually rigid in position, page shape and size. Exactly three cyan text strokes remain visible on each page in all three poses; there is no page flip, blank page, text disappearance or side swap.

It is nonblocking for this still concept review, but should be smoothed when drawing the animation frames.

Pose 1 is slightly less saturated than poses 2 and 3, while all three retain coherent turquoise strokes on the same dark background.

observations: Independently viewed the shared available-blink-1 anchor and all three canonical images at original detail. Each image contains one recognisable MIST face with fixed eye spacing and face footprint, connected C-eye/lid strokes and a small closed mouth.

The outlined note stays fixed below and to the right of the face, clear of both eyes and the mouth. The pen masks different portions of the note's upper border as it advances, without an apparent sheet jump.

The initial ink starts at the same left location and remains present as the right endpoint extends in poses 2 and 3. The pen tip meets the ink endpoint in every selected pose; no visible contact gap remains.

The pen advances a small distance between Prepare and Draw, then farther to Finish. The finish also relaxes the lids and introduces a closed smile, providing a clear end beat. The middle pose has no stray mark or disappearing ink.

The finish eye contours retain slight bumps at the joins between the curved upper lids and outer arcs. These stay connected and do not read as duplicate eyes or detached eyebrows, but are small contour drift relative to the anchor.

observations: Independently viewed the shared available-blink-1 anchor and all three canonical images at original detail. Each is a native square image with one MIST face, stable face footprint and eye spacing, coherent turquoise/dark palette and no stray marks.
Both C openings face left in pose 1 and right in pose 2. Pose 3 returns to the outward-facing attentive pair and a restrained closed smile, making the search and find progression legible.
The magnifier is small, thin and clearly secondary. It remains well below the eyes with generous empty space, and clear of the mouth in all three poses.

The magnifier moves a short horizontal distance right in pose 2 and settles between the two earlier positions in pose 3. Handle angle remains visually consistent. The middle pose preserves a clean face and prop.

The magnifier ring is slightly larger and thicker in poses 2 and 3 than in pose 1. The final position is slightly beyond the exact midpoint, and the finish smile sits somewhat higher than the prior flat mouth. These are nonblocking still-concept drift, not exact rigid-prop continuity.
